title: useful auto fire click detector
features:
When Toggled it will check if the part your mouse is on has a click detector and if so than it constantly fires that click detector.
if you have hold to toggle on than it will only constantly fire that click detector if you have left click held down
script:
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local Toggle = false
local Hold = false
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theneutral0ne/wally-modified/refs/heads/main/wally-modified.lua")))()
local Window = Library:CreateWindow('Credit: Neutral')
Window:Section("Click Detector")
Window:Toggle("Auto Fire Detector",{},function(value)
Toggle = value
end)
Window:Toggle("Hold to Toggle?",{},function(value)
Hold = value
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Toggle then
        if  Mouse.Target and Mouse.Target.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector") then
            if Hold and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
            fireclickdetector(Mouse.Target.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector"))
        end
    end
end)
